note: FIRST-EXECUTION TRIAGE RATCHET for the O-29 Feature lanes. Switching on a lane that has never executed surfaces pre-existing reds in bulk; the repo's answer to bulk pre-existing red is an enumerated shrink-only ratchet, never a blanket waiver. Each key is one test target — `Tests\Feature\<Group>\SomeTest` for a whole class, or `Tests\Feature\<Group>\SomeTest::test_method` for one method — and `Tests\TestCase::setUp()` markTestSkipped()s exactly those targets, and ONLY when the environment variable AUTOERP_QUARANTINE=1 (set on the eight Feature-lane CI jobs and by scripts/run-feature-lane-local.sh). With the variable unset this file has NO effect on any run, anywhere. Enforced by tools/feature-lane-manifest-check.php: `ceiling` is a non-growth ceiling on the number of entries, every entry must name an existing class file plus a declared `lane`, a `reason` and an `opened` date, and a stale entry (class file gone) is a hard failure so the list cannot rot into fiction. Deleting this file removes the quarantine entirely, which is strictly safer than keeping it, so its absence is not an error. Baselining protocol and the shrink obligations are in docs/handoff/DESIGN-f2-feature-lane-execution-2026-08-21.md §6.
